Site.description: A blog by Oyatillo Abdishukurov about frontend engineering — React, Next.js, TypeScript and the lessons from building real products.

HomePage.about: Hi, I'm Oyatillo — a frontend engineer in Tashkent. I spend my days in React, Next.js and TypeScript, building the kind of interfaces people work in all day. This is where I write about it: the bugs that taught me something, the tricks that made an app faster, and the things I wish someone had explained to me earlier.
